picks.name: Asa Tate
picks.source_note: New release on Rhythm Section International.
picks.bio: "Andromeda" (July 17, 2026) is a four-track EP -- Traffic, Andromeda, Echotex (Freak Mix), Echotex (Deep Dub) -- exploring a darker, more introspective path drawing from US proto house and techno.
picks.why_listen: Rawer and more sub-driven than typical Rhythm Section fare -- a good pick when you want proto-house grit rather than polish.

picks.name: Vague Imaginaires
picks.source_note: New release on Multi Culti (World Records).
picks.bio: Denis Morin's project, expanding his 'Island' series. "L'Île Sans Frontières" (July 25, 2026) is a five-track EP -- Le Village, Dauphin Dance, Mon Chat a Bali, My Soul Can Sing, Club Nostalgic -- blending ambient techno, house, field recordings, spoken word and dubby textures, featuring auto-tuned voices gathered through workshops with migrant communities.
picks.why_listen: Sits between club music and full trip-out sound art -- a good pick for a set's more reflective, texturally rich moments.
